acceptanceCriteria: A reviewed .corvint/shared-paths.json is committed and `corvint changes` enforces it on this repo, with a test.
The update service contract is bound to the corvint-tasks service (launchd/systemd) with a live check, or the binding is declined with reason.
rollback stops and restarts the bound service under the same live-attempt guard, with a test.
body: PR #1059 delivered SPC-V0-001..008 (shared-path change policy) and UPD-V0-011..014 (corvint-update service coordination). Residuals: (1) the repository ships no `.corvint/shared-paths.json` policy, so the check has nothing to enforce here; (2) service control is a generic `PROGRAM status|stop|start|live-attempts` contract and is not bound to launchd, systemd or the corvint-tasks service (V1-0697); (3) `corvint-update rollback` does not drive the service. UPD-V0-011..014 tests failed locally under load at the version-smoke step ('descendant snapshot unavailable'); CI decides.
title: shared-path policy file and update-service binding (V1-1591/1599 residuals)
